intent_contract.text: 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
Test conspicuous luxury as an original, highly prominent, coherently repeated non-letter house-code system integrated into a constructed object inside an unrelated complex orbital-travel narrative.

Create a cinematic editorial photograph of an adult fictional woman whose general appearance follows the attached portrait: long center-parted dark wavy hair, brown eyes, a softly oval facial outline, natural brows, and calm focused poise. In a rain-lashed orbital ferry terminal at night, she rotates a sculptural oxblood-and-black leather diplomatic case toward press cameras during a one-minute launch countdown. The case carries a large original non-letter emblem formed from an asymmetrical crescent and stepped hexagon, with the same geometric code repeating at controlled scale across the side panels and brushed-metal latch. The emblem is embossed into the leather and precisely aligned with seams, reinforced edges, and hardware, making the mark, repetition, and construction readable together. Use a three-quarter full figure with a detailed object foreground, wet brutalist concrete, blue launch light, warm reflected metal, and crisp leather grain. Blank label plates and abstract symbols keep the design fictional and brand-neutral.
